Welcome To The Love Club!

Where wedding dress shopping feels like a celebration, and the party starts when you walk in.

Born originally from Beloved Bridal in 2019, The Love Club is our next chapter: bold, modern, and unapologetically unique. We’re here for the fashion girls, the romantics, the rule-breakers — every bride rewriting what “classic” means.

At The Love Club, we’ve got something for every bride, every vibe, and every budget. Our sample gowns (off the rack) collection starts at $500, while our made-to-order gowns begin at $1800-$5500 with majority of our brides falling in love in the $2500-$3500 range.

Our Designers

Our designers are handpicked for their artistry and edge — gowns with soul, texture, movement, and that “THIS IS SO ME” energy.

FAQs

Don't see your question here?
Feel free to contact us!

We carry US street sizes 6-24 in the shop to try on!

Our dresses range from $1800-$4200. Majority of our collection falls within the $2300-$3600 price range.

We don't do in-house alterations, but we do have a list of talented seamstresses we recommend to our brides!

We recommend beginning your dress search 10-12 months before your wedding. Dresses typically take anywhere from 6-8 months to ship. Ordering within that 10-12 month period ensures the least amount of stress/rushing during the alterations process, and allowing yourself time to plan around your schedule!

We are an appointment only boutique. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions about the appointment options we offer!

Signature Styling appointments are 1.5 hour appointments. Our VIP option is 2 hours!

When scheduling your appointment you have the option to schedule a Champagne Experience or VIP Experience which includes champagne options!

Aside from your lovely self, any undergarment you're considering wearing! Nude underwear/shapewear can help visualize. You won't be wearing a bra on your wedding day, so nipple covers, silicone stick on cups are perfect options! If you have your shoes, you are more than welcome to bring those! Having those will come in handy if the designer of your dress offers custom hem. If you don't have your shoes, no worries! Most of the appointment you will be getting in and out on the pedestal, so they aren't a necessity!

Due to limited space, we ask our brides to limit their groups to 5 guests max. This ensures the best, most intimate, and focused experience for each bride. Dressing rooms 1 + 2 are positioned in the middle of the show room, and the third has the capability to be private. If you find you have 6-9 guests, you are more than welcome to schedule for our VIP package for the private back room. This allows you to invite up to 9 guests max.

While we can't carry entire collections from each of our designers, we can sometimes have the ability to request particular samples to loan. Please email if you'd like to inquire about requesting a gown that we don't carry in the shop at hello@theloveclubbridal.com

After payment has been made, we place an order with the designer of your gown! We may then go a little quiet while your gown is being made, but if you want to check in with us, please feel free! When your gown arrives, we do a quality check, and then follow up with you to schedule your pickup appointment! At that appointment you can try on veils and accessories that you have purchased or are looking to purchase!

We kindly ask that you give us at least 48 hours notice if you need to cancel or re-schedule your appointment. Notifying us within less than 24 hours will forfeit your styling fee refund. We thank you in advance for your cooperation and understanding!
